:::{#thm-zip-moments}

#### Mean and variance of the zero-inflated Poisson model

In a zero-inflated Poisson regression model (@def-zip-reg),
let $\pi \eqdef \pi(\vx) = \P(Z=1 \mid \vX=\vx)$ be the probability of a structural zero,
and let $\mu_0 \eqdef \E{Y \mid Z=0, \vX=\vx, T=t}$ be the mean count in the $Z=0$ arm.
Then:

$$
\ba
\E{Y \mid \vX=\vx, T=t} &= (1-\pi)\mu_0
\\
\Var{Y \mid \vX=\vx, T=t} &= (1-\pi)\mu_0(1+\pi\mu_0)
\ea
$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-zinf-moments, worked in @sol-zinf-moments.

:::
